messages:
marta: quick idea — add a 'deploycheck' subcommand to deploy-bot to tighten our release hygiene. it would: verify image pins, run a dry-run preflight, and emit a release-notes skeleton we can paste into the changelog. low-friction, opt-in per-team.

jason: sounds useful. can you sketch the UX/commands so we can evaluate integration risk? :thinking_face:   

marta: sure — rough CLI prototype below. goal is a single verb that teams call before a deploy, can run in CI or locally.

marta: ```
/deploybot deploycheck --env=prod --image=redwood/api:v2.4.1 --pin=sha256:abc123 \
  --window="23:00-03:00" --dry-run
```

marta: expected output: short pass/fail summary + collapsible release notes template, and a machine-readable JSON blob for pipeline gating. :white_check_mark:

rachel: concrete ask: make the pin check verify both tag->sha resolution and that the sha matches what we have in the model/infra manifest. reject if mismatch and include remediation steps. also include a flag to auto-attach the generated notes to the release PR. :+1:

sam: we should add a quick canary-capacity check: ensure enough instances in target pool for 5% canary. false positives are annoying, so maybe only warn when below threshold.

deploy-bot: noted — prototype run when invoked in dry-run mode:
```
deploy-bot: running deploycheck (dry-run)...
  - resolve tag: redwood/api:v2.4.1 -> sha256:abc123 (OK)
  - manifest pin match: failed (expected sha256:abc9ff, got sha256:abc123)
  - image reachable: OK
  - canary capacity: WARN (pool size 2 < recommended 4 for 5% canary)
  - lint + safe-rollout rules: OK
summary: FAIL (manifest pin mismatch). see logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/5467/logs
```

jason: good — that manifest mismatch is exactly the kind of thing that causes rollbacks. for rollout templates please include a default rollback-trigger snippet. example in generated notes:  

marta: ```
## Release notes (auto-generated)
- Summary: deploy redwood/api:v2.4.1 (resolved to sha256:abc123)
- Owner: @jason
- Rollout plan: canary 5% (30m) -> 25% (30m) -> 100%
- Rollback triggers: error-rate > 1% sustained for 10m OR latency p95 > 2s increase vs baseline
- Change window: 23:00-03:00 (UTC)
- Tickets: #1234, #5678
- PRs included: automation/bump-api, fixes/timeout-324
```

rachel: I'll take a pass on an initial PR. plan: add a small Go subcommand for the bot, a JSON schema for the machine output, and a knob in org-config for "deploycheck.enabled". will open WIP by EOD. :rocket:

sam: please include a small e2e test that mocks manifest mismatch and ensures CI fails the job. also a unit test for the template generator (we broke templates last time).

marta: thanks — if rachel posts the PR ping me and i'll help with the rollout plan and the canary capacity thresholds. once merged we gate behind a feature flag so teams opt in. :eyes:

jason: love it. long-term: consider adding an opt-in automated bump that creates the release notes PR and suggests rolling pins when mismatch is detected (human approves). but start small.

rachel: ack — will include migration notes and a short README snippet for eng teams with an example workflow.

marta: nice — this should cut down on last-minute rollbacks and make release notes less manual. thanks all. :clap:
